name: context-steward
description: Shows the context window's fill under the prompt and reminds the model once when it grows past a threshold

thresholdTokens.title: Reminder threshold (tokens)
thresholdTokens.description: Context size at which the meter turns into a warning and the model gets one reminder to suggest /compact or a handoff

stepTokens.title: Reminder step (tokens)
stepTokens.description: How much more the context must grow after a reminder before the next one
